title: Ittai
summary: Raleigh names Ittai in the History of the World (1617).
description: Named in Raleigh's History of the World (1617). Ittai, to whom with Ioab and Abishai Dauid disposed his forces against Absalom. No yeere of the World was taken for him. Display only. No tier 1–4 chronology dates this person, so there is no sort year.

sorting_basis.note: No tier gives a birth year. Raleigh is display-only.

free_source_links.locator: Book II, Part I, Chapter XVII, §. VII, sig. 297a
